_comment: Editorial content for MSCL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility exists on the open licence sources, and a generic industry photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Metropolitan Steel Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1955 and manufactures steel products, principally mild and high carbon steel wires, at its plant in the Landhi Industrial Area, Karachi. Its shares are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
headOffice: Plot No. HE-1/2, Landhi Industrial Area, Karachi
